items.title: Amazon S3
items.description: Amazon S3 for DVA-C02. Storage classes, versioning, lifecycle policies, presigned URLs, encryption (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, SSE-C), CORS, event notifications, multipart uploads, and cross-region replication.

items.title: API Design
items.description: Best practices for designing REST, gRPC, and GraphQL APIs including versioning, pagination, error handling, rate limiting, idempotency, and API gateway patterns.

items.title: Schema Migrations
items.description: Managing database schema changes safely in production — Flyway, Liquibase, zero-downtime migration patterns, and rollback strategies.
